positive_snippets:
It was a very good stay at Nature Valley Resort. We went it after searching many resorts but found this resort very good.

If we talk about rooms,  it was fine and comfortable. It was also clean.

Service was very good from staff.

But for food i would like to give 3 out of 5 rating as it was very average.
Lunch was Fine, Hi Tea was also fine, snacks was good,  dinner was average.
Breakfast average.

But for play sports, it is highly recommended.
If you are going with family then its a best option.

Overall we enjoyed a lot so highly recommended.

I had my birthday party with my friends and family. I will be honest in my experience.
It’s a huge place and you can do adventures, play pool and other games. Everyone was involved in it.
Even children had lots to do.
The rooms are also available and are very spacious. The staff is very accommodating and the best part is the food.
Go ahead and book it without any thought and you won’t be disappointed.

Amazing place to hangout. Staff was good and polite. Rooms were smelly but the complaint was addressed right away. Rooms could have been more clean. There were lizards but that’s due to trees and greenery everywhere. Food was average. Exactly like someone would want after having liquor-less masala. Breakfast options could have been better. Sambhar was sweet. Indoor games were not maintained good. Swimming pool activities were limited. Overall it maintained well this resort will bear every other resort with the mind of ambience it provides to its customers. My experience was awesome so still giving him 5 star else it would have been somewhere between 3.5 to 4.
negative_snippets:
The food is good however, the rooms are below average. Infact, washrooms are not good.
Its like a below average Oyo room. Swimming pool filtration is not working I guess. Since the pool was smelling like sweat. I was disgusted being there.

Bad experience. AC's hardly working. No wifi  signals. Flies in rooms. Other than swimming pool, no games and facilities. Huge but  poorly maintained property. They promise lot of games n facilities but  very few of the activities are in working state. Disappointed 😔
